package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	plannerpostgres "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root-only real persistence proof. A retained immutable owner-derived NO_CHANGE
// consequence is the input. Waiting and stale responses below are explicitly
// named repository fixtures; they are not asserted as actual Student responses.
func TestT204HybridApplicationPostgresLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	id := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T204_STORAGE_CONSEQUENCE_ID"))
	if dsn == "" || id == "" {
		t.Skip("root isolated database and exact queued actual consequence required")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("exact isolated Planner database required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	// Named delivery scheduling fixture: isolate selected genuine result, never
	// seed or modify evidence, mastery, path, snapshot, pins or consequence rows.
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO hybrid_application_work(consequence_id) SELECT consequence_id FROM hybrid_consequence_receipt ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE hybrid_application_work SET next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN consequence_id=$1 THEN clock_timestamp()-interval '1 hour' ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '48 hours' END WHERE NOT completed AND claim_token IS NULL`, id)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	work, found, err := store.ClaimHybridApplication(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || work.Consequence.Consequence.ConsequenceID != id {
		t.Fatalf("selected genuine queued consequence found=%v id=%s err=%v", found, work.Consequence.Consequence.ConsequenceID, err)
	}
	if work.Consequence.Consequence.Outcome != domain.HybridOutcomeNoChange {
		t.Fatal("root must choose retained real NO_CHANGE consequence distinct from actual AUTO proof")
	}
	c := work.Consequence.Consequence
	// Real lease expiration/restart; old token may neither complete nor release.
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE hybrid_application_work SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE consequence_id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	restarted := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	newWork, found, err := restarted.ClaimHybridApplication(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || newWork.ClaimToken == work.ClaimToken {
		t.Fatalf("lease restart lost work:%v", err)
	}
	receipt := domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{ConsequenceID: c.ConsequenceID, PayloadHash: work.Consequence.PayloadHash, LearningPathID: c.LearningPathID, PreviousRevision: c.ExpectedPathRevision, ResultingRevision: c.ExpectedPathRevision, Status: "NO_CHANGE", CommittedAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
	if err = store.CompleteHybridApplication(ctx, work, receipt); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("retired token completed newer lease:%v", err)
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridApplication(ctx, work, time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("retired token cleared newer lease:%v", err)
	}
	waiting := receipt
	waiting.Status = "WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY"
	if err = store.CompleteHybridApplication(ctx, newWork, waiting); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("waiting fixture terminally completed:%v", err)
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridApplication(ctx, newWork, time.Unix(1, 0)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	newWork, found, err = restarted.ClaimHybridApplication(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found {
		t.Fatal("durable waiting/outage retry lost work")
	}
	// Named DB transaction failure fixture forces rollback of stale result and
	// local queue increment, then restart retries exactly once.
	var beforeGeneration int64
	var beforeEvent string
	var beforeInbox int
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT generation,latest_event_id::text,(SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_planning_state_inbox) FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID).Scan(&beforeGeneration, &beforeEvent, &beforeInbox); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `CREATE FUNCTION t204_fail_application_fixture() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'T204_NAMED_DB_FAILURE_FIXTURE'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER t204_fail_application_fixture BEFORE INSERT ON hybrid_application_result FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION t204_fail_application_fixture();`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS t204_fail_application_fixture ON hybrid_application_result; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS t204_fail_application_fixture();`)
	}()
	if err = store.RecordHybridApplicationStale(ctx, newWork, "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE", time.Now().UTC()); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "T204_NAMED_DB_FAILURE_FIXTURE") {
		t.Fatalf("failure fixture missing:%v", err)
	}
	var generation int64
	var event string
	var inbox, results int
	var completed bool
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT generation,latest_event_id::text,(SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_planning_state_inbox),(SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_application_result WHERE consequence_id=$3),(SELECT completed FROM hybrid_application_work WHERE consequence_id=$3) FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, id).Scan(&generation, &event, &inbox, &results, &completed); err != nil || generation != beforeGeneration || event != beforeEvent || inbox != beforeInbox || results != 0 || completed {
		t.Fatalf("partial stale transaction gen=%d results=%d done=%v err=%v", generation, results, completed, err)
	}
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `DROP TRIGGER t204_fail_application_fixture ON hybrid_application_result; DROP FUNCTION t204_fail_application_fixture();`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = restarted.RecordHybridApplicationStale(ctx, newWork, "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE", time.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = restarted.RecordHybridApplicationStale(ctx, newWork, "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE", time.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("stale exact replay:%v", err)
	}
	var reason string
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT generation,latest_event_id::text,COALESCE(local_reason,''),(SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_planning_state_inbox),(SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_application_result WHERE consequence_id=$3),(SELECT completed FROM hybrid_application_work WHERE consequence_id=$3) FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, id).Scan(&generation, &event, &reason, &inbox, &results, &completed); err != nil || generation != beforeGeneration+1 || event != beforeEvent || reason != "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE" || inbox != beforeInbox || results != 1 || !completed {
		t.Fatalf("stale exact replay fabricated fact or multiple generations gen=%d event=%s reason=%s inbox=%d result=%d done=%v err=%v", generation, event, reason, inbox, results, completed, err)
	}
	for _, sql := range []string{`UPDATE hybrid_application_result SET reason_code=reason_code WHERE consequence_id='` + id + `'`, `DELETE FROM hybrid_application_result WHERE consequence_id='` + id + `'`, `TRUNCATE hybrid_application_result`} {
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, sql); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("retained application result mutated")
		}
	}
	t.Logf("actual PG durable application restart/rollback/stale result PASS consequence=%s; named repository stale fixture preserved real event=%s", id, event)
}

// Run after the actual registered Student delivery composer, so the terminal
// receipt below is an actual owner receipt, not a synthetic repository fixture.
func TestT204HybridApplicationPostgresTerminalReplay(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	id := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T204_COMPLETE_CONSEQUENCE_ID"))
	if dsn == "" || id == "" {
		t.Skip("root exact already-applied real consequence required")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("exact isolated Planner database required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	var work domain.HybridApplicationWork
	var consequenceRaw, receiptRaw []byte
	var status string
	var done bool
	err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT c.job_id::text,c.payload_hash,c.consequence_json,c.committed_at,r.owner_receipt_json,r.status,w.completed FROM hybrid_consequence_receipt c JOIN hybrid_application_result r USING(consequence_id) JOIN hybrid_application_work w USING(consequence_id) WHERE c.consequence_id=$1`, id).Scan(&work.Consequence.JobID, &work.Consequence.PayloadHash, &consequenceRaw, &work.Consequence.CommittedAt, &receiptRaw, &status, &done)
	if err != nil || !done || status == "STALE" {
		t.Fatalf("actual terminal owner receipt missing status=%s done=%v err=%v", status, done, err)
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(consequenceRaw, &work.Consequence.Consequence) != nil {
		t.Fatal("stored consequence corrupt")
	}
	var receipt domain.HybridApplicationReceipt
	if json.Unmarshal(receiptRaw, &receipt) != nil || domain.ValidateHybridApplicationReceipt(receipt, work.Consequence.Consequence) != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual stored owner receipt corrupt")
	}
	// A replay handle has no power to execute; exact immutable terminal content
	// succeeds even after its original delivery lease/token disappeared.
	work.ClaimToken = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("t204-terminal-replay-handle")).String()
	work.LeaseUntil = time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Minute)
	for n := 0; n < 3; n++ {
		if err = store.CompleteHybridApplication(ctx, work, receipt); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("terminal exact replay:%v", err)
		}
	}
	changed := receipt
	changed.CommittedAt = changed.CommittedAt.Add(time.Microsecond)
	if err = store.CompleteHybridApplication(ctx, work, changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("changed same-ID receipt accepted:%v", err)
	}
	var results int
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_application_result WHERE consequence_id=$1`, id).Scan(&results); err != nil || results != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("replay duplicated result count=%d err=%v", results, err)
	}
	t.Logf("actual committed owner receipt exact terminal replay PASS consequence=%s status=%s", id, status)
}
